notes: G3 spec (amount+1 on the planeswalker count). Printed: 'At the beginning of each end step, if a creature died this turn, you may put a loyalty counter on A Liliana planeswalker you control.' You control two Liliana planeswalkers (Liliana, Waker of the Dead and Liliana, Death Mage; different names, so the legend rule keeps both), each at 3 loyalty. Your Bear dies; at your end step you take the may and choose Death Mage: it goes to 4, Waker of the Dead stays at 3.
